fig1_a1c.png: Structure 1: a carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms (CH4), all bonds drawn.
fig1_a2c.png: Structure 2: CH3–O–CH3, an oxygen atom with two lone pairs bonded to two CH3 groups.

fig1_a5c.png: Structure 5: CH2=CH2, two carbon atoms joined by a double bond.
